name: Etsy Fields
description: Provides an Etsy-specific 'Etsy price' field type, widget and formatter (amount/divisor/currency_code) for use on the Etsy Listing entity type. Submodule of Etsy API.
project_description: Etsy Fields is a submodule of the Etsy API project. It provides field plugins specific to Etsy Listing data: an 'Etsy price' field type (etsy_price) storing an integer amount, an integer divisor and a currency code, together with a matching default widget and default formatter. The price is displayed as amount/divisor with the currency symbol/code resolved from the base module's supported-currency map. It depends on the etsy base module.
